unit_economics_interpretation: Revenue of USD 74,550 produced a 7.10% yield on originations, but total costs of USD 80,850 resulted in a net loss of USD 6,300. The funding cost rate was 2.70%, while the net income margin was -0.60%. Per originated loan, revenue was USD 213 and costs were USD 231, for a negative contribution of USD 18; operating expenses more than offset the revenue after funding costs.

Total revenue was USD 61,120 against USD 42,560 in total costs, leaving net income of USD 18,560. Revenue yield was 6.37% of principal originated; the funding cost rate was 1.90%, and the net income margin was 1.93%. On a per-loan basis, revenue was USD 95.50, costs were USD 66.50, and net income was USD 29.00.

Total revenue of USD 119,400 exceeded total costs of USD 73,500, producing net income of USD 45,900. Revenue yield was 6.63% of originations, compared with a 1.75% funding cost rate and a 2.55% net income margin.
